body:
Fixes:
1. Treats: the rule says 'smaller', but today treats give +30 like other food. Fix: keep today's numbers, fix the words (treats = cheaper, same boost).
2. Bowl at home: nothing says how long it lasts, so one food would work forever. Fix: one food fills the bowl for one game day of play, then it's empty.
3. No food at all in your bag: Ms. Paws's line names the 3 foods ('Ms. Paws sells meat, fish, fruit & veggies').
Build better:
4. Each pet type gets one 'food group' word instead of its own food list (today 10 lists). A new pet = one word.
5. In the pet shop, each food shows who loves it ('Fish: cats and seals love it'), so kids don't have to remember.

comments.text: Done: approved in chat and in the book, 31 Oct. Written into 'Pet food: 3 food groups'.

short: Rules check 5: 3 food fixes, 2 build ideas, OK?
